spectres.name: Forged Frostbearer
spectres.acquisition: Verisium Ore deposits / Outcrops in maps
spectres.acquisitionNote: Spawns from Verisium Ore encounters. Raise from the killed corpse; added to your Desecrate pool once raised.
spectres.note: Workhorse cold damage spectre. Cold mortar projectiles shotgun with Greater Volley Support for strong single-target and AoE clear.

spectres.name: Wretched Defiler
spectres.acquisition: Tier 17 maps (Sanctuary, Citadel, Fortress, Abomination, Ziggurat); also the Invasive Adversaries atlas node
spectres.acquisitionNote: Rare revenant. Desecrate-able once raised. Pairs with Doryani's Prototype for negative-lightning resistance scaling.
spectres.note: Highest-budget damage spectre. Strong lightning burst plus summons. Heavy projectile clutter can cost FPS at high counts.

spectres.name: Syndicate Operative
spectres.acquisition: Betrayal Research encounters (Jun, Master in maps)
spectres.acquisitionNote: Found in the Syndicate Hideout (Research) and sometimes other Betrayal encounters. Desecrate-able once raised.
spectres.note: Fast attacker throwing curved dagger projectiles. Popular off-meta physical damage spectre.

spectres.name: Carnage Chieftain
spectres.acquisition: Act 2 - The Old Fields, The Broken Bridge
spectres.acquisitionNote: Desecrate in The Old Fields (Act 2) to spawn corpses, then raise. Added to your pool afterward.
spectres.note: Casts Mass Frenzy, granting Frenzy Charges (attack/cast/move speed + damage) to you and allies. Near-universal early utility pick.

spectres.name: Host Chieftain
spectres.acquisitionNote: Desecrate-able in Act 2 zones once raised.
spectres.note: Casts Mass Power, granting Power Charges (critical strike chance) to you and allies. Best once you have crit scaling.

spectres.name: Undying Evangelist
spectres.acquisitionNote: Desecrate-able in Act 3 zones once raised.
spectres.note: Projects a Proximity Shield that blocks projectile damage from outside it. Defensive layer for squishy builds; negligible offense.

spectres.name: Spectral Leader
spectres.acquisition: Tier 17 maps; also the Invasive Adversaries atlas node (can spawn in low tiers)
spectres.acquisitionNote: Action-speed aura is among the strongest buffs in the game. Desecrate-able once raised.
spectres.note: Casts an action-speed aura (~+20% action speed, high uptime). Top-tier support spectre for any build.

spectres.name: Primal Crushclaw
spectres.acquisition: Harvest - The Sacred Grove (tier 3 harvestable monster)
spectres.acquisitionNote: Raise from the killed Harvest monster. NOT Desecrate-able - Desecrate does not spawn Harvest mobs.
spectres.note: Applies elemental exposure (cold-focused) to lower enemy resistances. Useful resistance-shredding utility.

spectres.name: Miner (Lantern)
spectres.acquisitionNote: Desecrate-able in mine zones once raised.
spectres.note: Undead miner from the mine areas. Carried as a useful utility pick; specific ability not widely documented - evaluate in-game.

spectres.name: Coral Golem
spectres.acquisition: Curse of the Allflame (3.29) - ocean-floor league content
spectres.acquisitionNote: New 3.29 league monster. Golem-family - possibly tanky melee/physical. Spectre viability not yet established.
spectres.note: UNTESTED: new 3.29 Curse of the Allflame ocean monster. Try it and see - no community evaluation yet.
